summary: Brixmor Operating Partnership LP's 8-K discloses a September 27, 2026 agreement for JV Purchaser EP/BRX Holdings LLC, a venture with Everview Partners funds, to acquire Toronto-listed Slate Grocery REIT (the US-equivalent take-private/unilateral acquisition of a TSX-listed target). Brixmor effectively acquires 23 grocery-anchored centers (100% of 22, 50% of one) for $636 million; the JV takes the remaining 92 assets for $1.71 billion, with Everview holding 80% of that JV Portfolio. Watch regulatory/TSX closing conditions, joint-venture agreement execution, and financing or offer-premium disclosure gaps.
